in_marathi.name: Daaruk
in_marathi.long_meaning: Daaruk हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Daaruk is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Daaru’ meaning wood. It is the name of a sage in Hindu mythology, renowned for his strength and valor. He was the architect of the monkey kingdom, 'Kishkindha', and a trusted advisor to Lord Rama.
